BackgroundColorClass.helper: Background setting. Applies an allow-listed Bootstrap or site background class to the section.

CardCorners.helper: Card styling setting. Controls square or softly rounded card corners.

CardsPerRow.helper: Layout setting. Controls desktop card columns. Tablet is capped at two columns and mobile is one column.

CardStyle.helper: Card styling setting. Controls card border and shadow treatment.

ContainerWidth.helper: Layout setting. Controls the Bootstrap container width for the section content.

DefaultView.helper: Layout setting. Initial layout used by the card list.

IconColor.helper: Icon styling setting. Controls the card icon color treatment.

MarginBottom.helper: Spacing setting. Adds a Bootstrap margin-bottom utility class to the section.

MarginTop.helper: Spacing setting. Adds a Bootstrap margin-top utility class to the section.

PaddingBottom.helper: Spacing setting. Adds a Bootstrap padding-bottom utility class to the section.

PaddingTop.helper: Spacing setting. Adds a Bootstrap padding-top utility class to the section.
